info.name: Microservices TS
info.description:
Complete API collection for the **Profile Service** (GraphQL + REST health) and **Threat Triage Engine** (REST read API).

## Prerequisites

1. Start infrastructure with `docker compose up -d` in each project.
2. Import `environment.json` and select **Microservices TS — Local**.
3. Profile Service: `npm run start:dev` in `profile-service/` (port **3000**).
4. Threat Triage: `npm run start:dev` in `microservice-cyberalert/` (port **3001**).

## Swagger (OpenAPI)

| Service | URL |
|---------|-----|
| Profile Service | `GET {{profile_base_url}}/api/docs` |
| Threat Triage | `GET {{cyberalert_base_url}}/api/docs` |

## Authentication (Profile Service)

`createProfile` returns an `accessToken` (JWT, HS256, 1h expiry, `sub` = the new profile's id) alongside the created `profile`. The **Create Profile** request saves it to `{{access_token}}` automatically. `updateProfile` and `deleteProfile` require `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` and only succeed when the token's subject matches the target profile — anyone else gets `FORBIDDEN`.

## GraphQL error codes

| `extensions.code` | HTTP | Meaning |
|-------------------|------|--------|
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Validation failed |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | Username or email taken |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Profile not found |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | 412 | Version conflict on update |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | 401 | Missing/invalid bearer token on `updateProfile`/`deleteProfile` |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Token does not belong to the target profile |

item.name: Profile Service
item.description: NestJS + GraphQL + PostgreSQL + OpenSearch. Writes use transactional outbox → SNS → SQS → OpenSearch index.

request.description: Returns a single profile from PostgreSQL. Returns `null` when not found or soft-deleted.
Full-text search against OpenSearch (eventual consistency). Wait ~10s after create/update for indexing.
Creates a profile (username 3–30 alphanumeric/underscore) and issues a JWT `accessToken` scoped to it. Saves `profile_id`, `profile_version` and `access_token` to the environment.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` from the same profile (401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` without it, 403 `FORBIDDEN` with someone else's token). Optimistic locking via `version` (412 `PRECONDITION_FAILED` on stale version).
Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` from the same profile. Soft-deletes the profile (status INACTIVE). Subsequent `profile(id)` returns null; username can be reused.
Expect `extensions.code: CONFLICT` when username is taken.
Valid token, but for a *different* profile than the one being updated. Expect `extensions.code: FORBIDDEN` (403) — run 'Create Profile' twice and swap `profile_id` to see this against a real target.

item.name: Threat Triage Engine
item.description: Read-only REST API over consolidated threat intelligence. Write path is event-driven (SNS → SQS → worker).

request.description: Terminus health check including PostgreSQL ping.
List triaged threats ordered by `detectedAt` DESC. Optional filters: `severity`, `sourceIp`, `limit` (1–200).
Fetch a single threat by business `threatId` (UUID from the original event).
